title: Local and global properties of solutions of an elliptic equation involving exponential and gradient reaction
summary: We study some local and global properties of solutions of $-Δu- m\abs{\nabla u}^q-e^{u}=0$ in a punctured domain $Ω\setminus\{0\}$, or in an exterior domain of $R^N$, $N\geq 2$, where $m$ is a positive parameter and $q>1$. We study particularly the local behaviour of solutions with an isolated singularity or the asymptotic behaviour for solutions defined in an exterior domain, and also the existence of solutions with the behaviours previously described.
